description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the ratio, expressed as a percentage, for three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (brown), and ChatGPT (tan)—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis, labeled "Ratio (%)", is scaled linearly from 50 to 90, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10, indicating the percentage values for each bar. The horizontal axis presents the three knowledge categories in order from left to right: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. For each category, three bars are grouped side-by-side, representing the respective model's ratio. In the "Movies" category, the ratios are approximately 90% for Llama3, 90% for Qwen2, and 72% for ChatGPT. In the "Songs" category, the ratios are approximately 84% for Llama3, 90% for Qwen2, and 62% for ChatGPT. In the "Basketball" category, the ratios are approximately 67% for Llama3, 57% for Qwen2, and 61% for ChatGPT. The bars are not sorted by height, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar.
